title: A YouTube video from script to Shorts
lead: From one topic: an 8-11 minute video, vertical Shorts and thumbnails, with the checks done before handover.
problem: The client needed to release a video every week and several Shorts, but the script, voiceover, editing and thumbnails took all the time, and the channel came out irregularly.
built: A script of 1,100-1,350 words with a list of facts and sources.
Voiceover in an even synthetic voice; the video description says so.
Editing in which the picture changes with the meaning of the speech: maps, portraits, objects, captions burned into the frame.
Loudness set to one level: -14.1 LUFS on the finished video.
Shorts: vertical 1080x1920 videos of 49-51 seconds, one file for YouTube and TikTok.
steps: A script with facts and sources is written and voiced.
The video is edited to the meaning of the speech, then checked automatically.
You receive the video, Shorts, subtitles, thumbnails and upload text.
offer: A full 4K video, or a part of it: only Shorts, only voiceover and subtitles.
Upload files: the video, .srt subtitles, three thumbnails, a description with chapters and tags.
Revisions for each part; the number is in the service package.
not_included: Publishing on the channel; Any promise of views, subscribers or monetization.
price_en: Price: on request, after a short brief
